ns2:course.label: Techniques of Bio Psych
ns2:course.description: Introduction to research techniques used in the physiological study of mental processes: includes recording "brain waves," behavioral analysis of drug effects, anatomy of the brain, hormones and behavior, and related topics. The course will give students direct experience working with both human and laboratory animal subjects to qualify for more advanced course and research opportunities. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in PSYC 210, or consent of instructor.
